role: Introduce the workshop format and invite programme inspection
subject: What happens at ClayRoom
preview_text: Try instructor-led hand building with clay and tools provided.
headline: See what beginner hand building involves
body:
Curious about pottery, but unsure what a beginner workshop involves?

ClayRoom’s beginner pottery workshop introduces you to hand building. The clay and tools are provided, and an instructor guides the introduction so you can try shaping clay by hand.

This is **hand building, not a pottery-wheel session**. After the workshop, what you make is fired, and you collect the finished pieces once that firing is complete.

Inspect the programme to see whether this practical introduction to pottery is an activity you would like to explore.
